values.en: Limit of a Function at a Point

content.snl: def-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(list-partial(@x, @L), Real)), Analysis.funLim(F, @y, x, L), Logic.and(Logic.exists-typed(@delta, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(delta), Set.subset(Analysis.nbhDel(x, delta), Analysis.domain(F)))), Logic.forall-typed(@epsilon, Real, Logic.implies($#0 > 0$(epsilon), Logic.exists-typed(@delta, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(delta), Logic.forall-typed(@y, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(y, Analysis.nbhDel(x, delta)), Set.mem(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), y), Analysis.nbh(L, epsilon))))))))))

values.en:
`F` tends to `L` as `x → x₀` iff two things hold. First, well-posedness: some punctured neighbourhood `U°(x₀, delta)` lies inside `F.domain`, so the limit is asked at a point the function actually approaches. Second, the epsilon-delta clause: for every `epsilon > 0` there is `delta > 0` with `F.map x ∈ U(L, epsilon)` for all `x ∈ U°(x₀, delta)`.

The value at `x₀` itself is irrelevant — indeed `x₀` need not lie in the domain at all. That is precisely what the *punctured* neighbourhood encodes, and it is what separates this notion from continuity at `x₀`.
values.zh-CN:
`F` 趋于 `L`（当 `x → x₀` 时），当且仅当两件事成立。第一，适定性：某个去心邻域 `U°(x₀, delta)` 包含于 `F.domain`，从而所求极限位于函数确实能够趋近的点。第二，epsilon-delta 条件：对每个 `epsilon > 0`，都存在 `delta > 0`，使 `F.map x ∈ U(L, epsilon)` 对所有 `x ∈ U°(x₀, delta)` 均成立。

`x₀` 本身的函数值无关紧要——事实上，`x₀` 完全可以不属于定义域。这正是*去心*邻域所编码的内容，也是这一概念区别于 `x₀` 处连续性的关键。
